headline: Volkswagen Posts Third-Quarter Loss Over $6.5 Billion as Revenue Drops
summary: Volkswagen reported a third-quarter loss exceeding $6.5 billion after sales revenue fell 6% to 75.3 billion euros. Management warned the automaker must act quickly to cut costs.
why: Volkswagen AG is one of the world's largest automotive manufacturers, producing brands including VW, Audi, Porsche, and Skoda.

impacts.name: Volkswagen AG
impacts.why: Severe quarterly losses and falling revenues hurt investor sentiment for the German automaker.

why_moved: Volkswagen's largest quarterly loss in more than a decade sparked concerns over European automotive sector margins and operational costs.
